title: The Concept of Anomie in Modern Society
text:
Anomie describes a state of normlessness or deregulation within a society, where established social guidelines and moral expectations weaken. This condition can arise rapidly during periods of intense social change, such as industrial booms or economic depressions.

According to Durkheimian theory, the decline in shared collective consciousness leaves individuals unmoored, struggling with unclear behavioral standards. The absence of clear communal boundaries prevents goal attainment from feeling properly regulated, leading to increased rates of alienation and instability across various social metrics.
